title: Roman numerals
description: Add the Roman numerals tool to Pocket with the id `roman`, following AGENTS.md: src/logic/roman.js (toRoman(n) for 1..3999 and fromRoman(s), round trip.), src/tools/roman.js (the view), test/roman.test.mjs (node:test tests of the logic), and one entry in TOOLS in src/registry.js. Touch nothing else.
accept: node --input-type=module -e "import { toRoman, fromRoman } from './src/logic/roman.js'; if (toRoman(1994)!=='MCMXCIV'||fromRoman('MMXXVI')!==2026) process.exit(1)"
